    HEAP
)AS
SELECT * FROM SYN.STG_CORE_GENERALACCOUNTMASTER WHERE 1=0

SELECT COLUMN_NAME FROM INFORMATION_SCHEMA.COLUMNS WHERE TABLE_SCHEMA = 'D360' AND TABLE_NAME = 'SYN_STG_CORE_GENERALACCOUNTMASTER'

DECLARE @DATETOPROCESS DATE
SET @DATETOPROCESS = '2023-05-16';

TRUNCATE TABLE D360.SYN_STG_CORE_GENERALACCOUNTMASTER

INSERT INTO D360.SYN_STG_CORE_GENERALACCOUNTMASTER--SYN.STG_CORE_GENERALACCOUNTMASTER

select 
 GAM_ACID
,GAM_BANK_ID
,FORACID
,ACCT_NAME
,ACCT_SHORT_NAME
,NAT_LANG_TITLE_CODE
,NATIVE_LANG_NAME
,CUST_ID
,CIF_ID
,ACCT_OPN_DATE
,ACCT_CLS_DATE
,ACCT_CLS_FLG
,GAM_LAST6_ACC_NUM
,GAM_BNK_CODE AS BANK_CODE
,'CORE' AS GAM_SOURCE_CODE
,CAST(SYSDATETIMEOFFSET() AT TIME ZONE 'Singapore Standard Time' AS DATETIME) AS insert_dttm
from EDS.DEPOSIT_FACT DF WHERE AS_OF_DATE =  @DATETOPROCESS;
